title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.



Why Join Us?

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem


This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer

  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

• Implementação de pipelines de CI/CD com Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.

title: Shopify Solution Architect
description:
Job Title: Shopify Solution Architect

Location: Remote

Mode of Hire: Contract


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced e-commerce Solution Architect to design, scale, and optimize modern digital commerce ecosystems. This role will be responsible for building secure, scalable, and high-performing architecture that supports enterprise-level eCommerce operations.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Shopify and Adobe Magento, along with strong experience integrating complex systems across enterprise environments. You will work closely with engineering, product, marketing, and operations teams to ensure the eCommerce platform integrates seamlessly with core business systems and supports business growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable e-commerce architecture supporting enterprise digital commerce operations.
  • Lead platform architecture and integration strategies for Shopify and Adobe Magento environments.
  • Manage and optimize Shopify within a large, regulated enterprise environment, ensuring secure and reliable integrations.
  • Architect integrations between TikTok Shop and Shopify, including catalog management, order processing, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Oversee end-to-end e-commerce data flows including checkout, purchase orders, abandoned cart processes, and customer transactions.
  • Design integrations with enterprise systems such as SAP, APIs, and analytics/data platforms.
  • Ensure reliable data pipelines to analytics platforms such as Snowflake and other data warehouses.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and marketing teams to align technical architecture with business objectives.
  • Evaluate and implement digital experience tools that enhance customer engagement and conversion.
  • Ensure best practices around security, performance, scalability, and system reliability across the commerce ecosystem.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in eCommerce architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture roles.
  • Strong experience with Shopify and Adobe Magento platforms in enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience designing and managing complex system integrations using APIs and middleware.
  • Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify, including catalog, order, and fulfillment processes.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end eCommerce operations, including checkout flows, purchase orders, and abandoned cart workflows.
  • Experience integrating eCommerce platforms with ERP systems such as SAP.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture and analytics integrations, including Snowflake or similar platforms.
  • Experience working within regulated enterprise environments with strong security and compliance requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and digital experience tools.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and engagement platforms such as: Yotpo, Simon, Attentive
  • Experience with SMS, email marketing platforms, and customer reviews tools within the eCommerce ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of modern composable commerce architecture.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and marketing.


Key Skills

  • eCommerce Architecture
  • Shopify & Magento Platform Expertise
  • API & System Integrations
  • Enterprise Data Architecture
  • ERP Integrations (SAP)
  • Digital Experience Platforms
  • Cloud & Scalable Infrastructure
  • Cross-functional Technical Leadership

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA (Generative AI & Agentic Systems)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Gestão de Contratos e Facilities

  • Gerenciar contratos de manutenção industrial e facilities.

Gestão de Custos (OPEX e CAPEX)

  • Controlar custos de: Materiais e sobressalentes; Serviços e contratos

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida atuação em planejamento de manutenção industrial;
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos (CAPEX Sustaining);
  • Vivência em gestão de custos;
  • Domínio das ferramentas e metodologias de confiabilidade;
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de manutenção (SAP PM);
  • Vivência em projetos de melhoria contínua e confiabilidade.


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

title: Senior Tax and Accounting Manager
description:
About the Company

We are a high-growth technology company with annual revenue above BRL 300M , operating under an asset-light model and generating recurring revenue . Our operations span Brazil and the United States , and we are continuously evolving our financial and operational processes to support our growth.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Tax & Accounting Manager to join our Controllership team and lead the accounting and tax operations for our Brazilian and U.S. entities.

This is a strategic role responsible for ensuring compliance with BR GAAP and US GAAP , managing cross-border tax complexity, and driving process improvements, automation, and operational efficiency across the finance function.

You will lead a team of 4–7 professionals and work closely with leadership, auditors, and international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close under BR GAAP and US GAAP
  • Manage intercompany consolidation , eliminations, and reconciliations
  • Oversee the Brazilian tax operation , including direct and indirect tax calculations and statutory filings (SPED, ECF, ECD, etc.)
  • Coordinate the U.S. tax operation with external advisors
  • Manage transfer pricing processes between group entities
  • Lead the external audit process and act as the main point of contact with Big Four auditors
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements within NetSuite
  • Explore the use of AI and automation tools to improve reconciliations, financial close, and variance analysis
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the Accounting & Tax team
  • Provide financial insights and reporting to support leadership decision-making


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting with active CRC certification
  • Previous experience at a Big Four audit firm (Deloitte, EY, KPMG, or PwC)
  • 5+ years of corporate experience after Big Four, ideally in high-growth or technology companies
  • Strong knowledge of BR GAAP/IFRS and US GAAP
  • Experience with intercompany consolidation and transfer pricing
  • NetSuite experience as a primary ERP
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S. teams and auditors)
  • Experience leading and developing accounting or tax teams


Nice to Have

  • Strong background in tax and fiscal disciplines
  • Experience with Brazilian tax incentives (Lei do Bem, Lei de Informática)
  • Familiarity with tax automation tools
  • Experience implementing AI or RPA in accounting processes
  • Experience optimizing NetSuite workflows, scripts, or dashboards
  • Postgraduate degree or certifications such as CPA or MBA in Finance


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong ownership mindset and proactive problem-solving
  • Ability to challenge manual processes and drive improvements
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to translate complex technical topics to leadership
  • Interest in technology, automation, and innovation within finance

description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.

Diferenciais

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts


Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently


Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines


Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
description:
Location: LATAM

Department: Success Department

Role: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)

Mode: Full-time


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the go-to resource for top-tier customers to ensure successful product adoption and retention. This role entails handling clients onboarding, clients retention, and success planning.


Our ideal candidate will have the experience of working in a B2B SaaS company, and handling a fair share of different business processes. We are seeking someone who can ensure that our clients receive a great experience while working with us.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their goals and help them maximize the value of the Respond.io platform
  • Assist customers during the onboarding process, ensuring a positive and smooth experience
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a point of contact for customer issues and ensure timely resolution
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, use cases, and objectives to ensure effective utilization of the Respond.io platform
  • Monitor and report on customer satisfaction and platform usage
  • Focus on maintaining high customer satisfaction and retention rates
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the Respond.io platform and identify opportunities for customer growth, collaborating with the internal team to propose upsells


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Consulting, and Account Management
  • Experienced in working with international customers and handling global accounts
  • Attentive listener with an ability to address customer concerns effectively
  • Strong communication skills in Arabic and English to convey complex ideas clearly
  • Skilled in negotiating complex renewal contracts in a SaaS environment
  • Proficient in optimizing complex business processes
  • Familiarity with business messaging platforms, CRM systems, and Customer Success tools
  • Passionate about digital transformation and understanding diverse businesses
  • Ability to provide customer feedback and insights to various departments for product improvement
  • Deep understanding of our products, industry trends, and competition
  • Able to quickly grasp technical concepts and keen to become an expert in our software
  • An agile team player who is excited by the fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to make a difference


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).

About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)

title: Senior Content Manager

  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations

The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency

You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills

What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.

  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About the Job

What if every conversation you have, every partnership you build, could accelerate the progress of life science research and precision medicine?

At GeneMind, we are dedicated to making life readable and health actionable through independent innovation in high-throughput gene sequencing technology. We break global technological barriers, deliver accessible and reliable genomic tools to laboratories, hospitals, and research institutions worldwide, and empower scientists and clinicians to turn data into discovery—and discovery into real-world impact.

Working at GeneMind means joining a mission-driven team that combines cutting-edge R&D, industrial execution, and global growth. You will not only sell products but also shape the future of the genomics industry. Supported by passionate innovators, strong technical platforms, and a fast-growing global market, you will grow faster, achieve more, and build a meaningful career in one of the most promising fields of our time.


Position Summary

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Sales Specialist / Sales Manager will be the key commercial driver for GeneMind in assigned territories. You will build channel ecosystems, develop key accounts and KOL networks, drive market expansion, and deliver sustainable sales growth. This is a customer-centric, technical, and strategic sales role that combines channel management, key customer development, market insight, and cross-team collaboration—not just order execution. You will directly contribute to GeneMind’s global expansion and market leadership in next-generation sequencing (NGS).


Key Measures Of Success

  • Achievement of quarterly and annual sales targets, revenue, and order intake
  • Healthy channel partner development, activation, and retention
  • Successful development of key accounts and KOL relationship building
  • Accurate market intelligence collection and competitive strategy support
  • High customer satisfaction and long-term partnership loyalty
  • Effective product training and capability improvement for channel partners


Position Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage channel partners in assigned regions, expand market coverage, and build a stable, high-quality distribution system.
  • Identify and develop key customers and KOLs; establish long-term, trusted professional relationships.
  • Collect and analyze market dynamics, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs to support regional sales strategies.
  • Deliver professional product presentations and online/offline training to channel partners to improve their sales and technical capabilities.
  • Support partners to close deals, including joint customer visits, demand analysis, solution design, and project follow-up.
  • Develop and execute quarterly and annual regional sales plans, ensure target delivery, and maintain healthy sales funnel management.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including technical support, marketing, and customer service to ensure smooth project delivery and excellent customer experience.
  • Represent GeneMind in academic and industry activities to enhance brand influence and market penetration.

The above responsibilities are representative but not exhaustive; duties may be adjusted to meet business needs.


Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Medicine, Molecular Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields ; Master’s degree is a strong plus.
  • Minimum 3 years of working experience in the NGS / sequencing industry .
  • Demonstrated experience in sales, channel development, or key account management in life science instruments, IVD, or sequencing-related fields.
  • Experience selling sequencing instruments or related laboratory equipment is highly preferred.
  • Professional, self-motivated, and target-oriented with strong learning and communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build trust with partners, KOLs, and research clients.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently as needed.
  • High integrity, customer-first mindset, and alignment with GeneMind’s mission and values.


Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in the life science or IVD industry.
  • Existing channel resources, customer network, or KOL connections in regional markets.
  • Experience in technical sales or solution-based sales (not just transactional).
  • Strong presentation, training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Familiarity with NGS workflows, clinical diagnostics, or life science research scenarios.
  • Global market exposure or cross-cultural communication experience is a plus.


Who We Are

GeneMind is a leading global innovator and manufacturer of gene sequencing systems with independent core intellectual property. We develop and produce high-performance sequencing platforms to support scientific research and precision medicine across the globe. We embrace diversity, encourage growth, and empower every team member to create real impact.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Arquiteto(a) de Software
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Requisitos


Responsabilidades Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de software alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e às diretrizes organizacionais; Desenvolver soluções técnicas que atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, desempenho e segurança; Atuar como referência técnica em projetos, colaborando com equipes de engenharia e produto; Garantir a qualidade do código e a integridade das soluções, apoiando revisões e boas práticas; Utilizar ferramentas de automação e CI/CD para assegurar integridade e performance dos sistemas; Analisar arquiteturas de sistemas e processos existentes, identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias; Documentar arquiteturas utilizando padrões reconhecidos (ex. C4) e disseminar boas práticas entre times; Conduzir discussões técnicas e apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica junto a stakeholders de tecnologia. Requisitos Técnicos Domínio de arquiteturas de software avançadas, incluindo microserviços, serverless e monólitos modulares; Experiência sólida em desenho de soluções escaláveis, seguras e resilientes; Vivência prática com ferramentas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD); Capacidade de atuação em equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo colaboração e qualidade técnica; Visão sistêmica sobre impacto de decisões arquiteturais em ambientes de TI complexos. Espanhol avançado (obrigatório), para atuação direta com stakeholders e clientes LATAM. Diferenciais Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem em pelo menos um dos principais provedores (AWS, Azure ou GCP); Conhecimento em padrões de documentação arquitetural, como C4; Experiência em consultoria, atuando em múltiplos contextos e clientes; Inglês avançado, para interação em projetos internacionais.

Espanhol avançado



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

title: Sales/Account Executive (healthcare)
description:
Job Title: Sales Development Representative (Genetic Testing Industry)


1. Company Background

The client company is a genetic testing and research company based in the US. Leveraging artificial intelligence, we analyze customers’ genetic information to predict potential diseases and provide insights that help individuals make informed decisions about their health.


2. Role Background

We are seeking a motivated and professional Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our team. This role requires a unique blend of scientific knowledge, strong communication skills, and sales expertise. The SDR will be responsible for generating leads, managing the sales pipeline, conducting outreach, and guiding prospects through the sales cycle—from initial contact to deal closure.


The ideal candidate will speak good English, with experience in US genomics companies preferred but not required.


3. Responsibilities

  • Qualify leads and manage the sales pipeline through proactive outreach and consistent follow-ups.
  • Conduct sales meetings and presentations using the company’s training materials to explain products and services.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally in English (and Spanish when applicable), ensuring strong verbal and written communication.
  • Present professionally on video calls, maintaining an appropriate background, appearance, and demeanor.
  • Confidently learn and discuss genetics-related topics to engage effectively with clients.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle—from lead generation to contract closure—handling deals ranging from $100,000 to $2 million.
  • Respond promptly to client inquiries and diligently follow up to move opportunities forward.
  • Conduct outreach via phone and email, as well as respond to inbound calls.
  • Participate in the hiring process by recording an application video and delivering a presentation using company training materials.


4. Qualifications

  • Advanced English proficiency: clear verbal communication, strong written skills, and the ability to present confidently (accent acceptable if communication is clear).
  • Previous sales experience, ideally in genetics, biotech, or related industries.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to track discussions, manage follow-ups, and prioritize effectively.


5. Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in US genomics companies.


6. Schedule

  • Full-time (40 hours/week): Monday to Friday - US hours.
  • Flexible working hours may be required based on client schedules across different time zones.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)

You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.
